takes.h: Good Smile Company's Nendoroid Gamera from Gamera 2: Assault of the Legion
takes.p: The Toyark reports Good Smile Company's Nendoroid Gamera (1996), based on Gamera 2: Assault of the Legion, stands approximately 4 inches tall and comes with plasma fireball and abdomen effects and a display stand. Shipping is listed for April to June 2027; direct orders include a 60th Anniversary logo sheet.
